data.crop_rule: most degraded blocks among all windows of this size that contain no foreground block
data.note: one frame of one run, chosen by a stated rule -- an illustration of the mechanism, never evidence of an effect size; the quantitative claims are in the restorer catalogue and the rate-matched comparison

sentence: Four panels from one frame of a single bear run. The first places a 96-by-96 pixel crop in the full frame and shades the blocks the selector chose for degradation in red, with the protected foreground outlined in blue; the selected blocks fall in the background and none overlaps the foreground. The remaining three show the same crop pristine, as transmitted after per-block downsampling, and after client-side restoration: the transmitted crop is visibly softened and the restored crop recovers texture without recovering it exactly.
